slices.focus: Nadia turns her spreadsheet into a shared deadline-reminder system for 30-day and 90-day follow-ups across the team.
slices.summary: With help from an agency data volunteer, Nadia converts her private tracking spreadsheet into a shared reminder system that flags upcoming 30-day and 90-day deadlines for every caseworker. The tool makes deadline visibility team-wide rather than dependent on Nadia's personal monitoring. She plans to watch for independent usage (do staff check it before asking her), track whether late paperwork spreads out instead of clustering, and redirect 'just tell me what's urgent' questions back to the shared view.
open_loops: Monitor whether staff check the shared view independently before asking for guidance
Track whether late paperwork deadlines begin to spread out instead of clustering
Document examples of the shift from 'emergency questions' to 'capacity questions'
Continue jotting one-sentence notes at the end of the day
decisions: Nadia shifted from only using dashboard-based complexity assignment to also running a shared reminder system for 30-day
